{{Top}}
{{Quote|Don't move, sleemo!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|<ref name="Children">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
'''Sleemo''' was a [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] insult, pronounced ''slay-mo'', and literally translating as "slimeball".<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while preparing his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] for the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], faced taunts from his [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] rival, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. Undeterred, Skywalker insulted Sebulba by calling him "sleemo," to which Sebulba responded by labeling Skywalker as "[[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha poodoo]]."<ref name="TPM" />

[[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years later]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] was deceived into believing that Skywalker, now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], was coming to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him; leading the angry [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to label Skywalker as "[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sleemo."<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

In [[137 ABY]], [[Zareb Syn]] and [[Rav]] were destroying the camp of some gem [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rasi Tuum]], trying to defend the miners, attacked them both. In the heat of the fight, Syn attacked Tuum unexpectedly from behind, angrily proclaiming, "Jedi can die too, sleemo!" Zareb was ultimately killed in the struggle.<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>
